meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Saudi Arabia merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) institutional core
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Saudi statistical system.
reports._cadence_evidence: GASTAT homepage is the institutional portal, not a publication: it carries a rolling 'إصدارات التقويم الإحصائي' (Statistical Calendar) of forthcoming releases (business statistics June 2026, Umrah Q1 2026, construction cost July 2026, trade June 2026) and a catalogue of 5,758 entries tagged Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly. No single cadence applies to the page itself.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.description: Official population census and estimates. Population is approximately 35 million; the structure includes a large non-Saudi workforce and rapid urbanisation under Vision 2030 projects.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched page titled 'Population Estimates Statistics 2024' on GASTAT's site with Population_Estimates_Publication_2024_EN.pdf/xlsx downloads.
reports._cadence_evidence: GASTAT 'Population Estimates Statistics 2024' - a year-labelled edition (PDF + Excel) sitting in GASTAT's 'Yearly' periodicity category; the page itself carries no explicit frequency text, but the series is issued one edition per reference year.

reports.title: National Accounts of Saudi Arabia (GDP)
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP). The economy remains oil-dominated but non-oil activity has expanded under Vision 2030; real growth has been positive in recent periods with diversification progress tracked closely.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Oil still dominant; non-oil share rising.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched GASTAT 'GDP - Flash Estimate Q2/2026' page, categorised under National Accounts Statistics, with PDF/Excel GDP data.
reports._cadence_evidence: GASTAT 'GDP - Flash Estimate Q2/2026'; page metadata keywords include 'quarterly' and the edition is quarter-labelled, i.e. one flash estimate per quarter.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been moderate in recent periods under the riyal peg and active demand management.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched GASTAT 'Consumer Price Index July 2026' release page under Prices Statistics, with CPI Jul 2026-EN PDF and tables.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Oil exports dominate the current account; large net foreign assets and reserves are structural features of the external position.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under oil-export dominance and large reserve buffers.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched SAMA 'Monthly Bulletin Statistics' page, which states it covers external sector data including balance of payments and international investment position.
reports._cadence_evidence: SAMA Monthly Bulletin Statistics page: 'The bulletin contains the latest monetary and financial statistics relating to banking activity, the activity of finance companies, payment systems, exchange rates, and interest rates' - a monthly bulletin. This URL is shared with sa-banking, so 12/yr is the shared bulletin's cadence, not two separate series.

reports.title: Crude oil production statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on crude oil production. Production is managed under OPEC+ frameworks and remains the dominant real-sector and external-earnings activity; volumes fluctuate with quota and market policy.
reports._notes: Core real-sector production node. Highest-centrality commodity for Saudi Arabia.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched GASTAT document landing page for 'Oil and Gas Statistics 2025 EN.pdf', GASTAT's official oil and gas production publication.
reports._cadence_evidence: GASTAT 'Oil and Gas Statistics 2025' is one edition of a year-labelled annual series (2023, 2024 and 2025 editions all published on stats.gov.sa). Shared URL with sa-oil-exports - this is the single annual publication's cadence covering both production and export tables.

reports.title: Crude oil export statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on crude oil export volumes. Oil exports dominate merchandise exports and current-account credits.
reports._url_evidence: Same GASTAT 'Oil and Gas Statistics 2025' publication also carries crude oil export volumes; no separate GASTAT oil-export product page exists.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same document as sa-oil-production: GASTAT 'Oil and Gas Statistics', annual year-labelled editions (2023, 2024, 2025). Export volumes are tables inside that one annual release, so the cadence is the shared series' 1/yr.

reports.title: Oil revenue and fiscal dependence statistics
reports.description: Statistics on oil revenues as a share of total budget revenue. Oil remains the largest single revenue source, though non-oil revenue has risen under Vision 2030 fiscal reforms (VAT, fees, etc.).
reports._notes: Core fiscal-oil nexus node. Non-oil revenue share is rising.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched Ministry of Finance page titled 'Budget Statement 2026' with 'Budget in Numbers' revenue sections.
reports._cadence_evidence: Saudi Ministry of Finance page is 'Budget Statement FY 2026' with pre-budget and budget statement downloads, one set per fiscal year; no quarterly performance reports appear on this page.

reports.title: Vision 2030 non-oil GDP and diversification framing
reports.description: Policy and statistical framing of Vision 2030 diversification. Non-oil GDP share has risen to around half or more of the economy in recent readings; private-sector and SME contributions are tracked as core success metrics.
reports._notes: Highest-centrality diversification and policy densification node.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched official Vision 2030 page whose title is 'Saudi Vision 2030 - 2025 Annual Report' (the annual progress/diversification report series).
reports._cadence_evidence: vision2030.gov.sa/en/annual-reports is the Vision 2030 annual report library; the current edition shown is the 2025 Annual Report, one per year.

reports.title: Labour force and Saudization statistics
reports.publisher: GASTAT / Ministry of Human Resources related
reports.description: Labour-force participation, unemployment and Saudization indicators. Overall and Saudi unemployment have declined markedly; female participation has risen; private-sector Saudi employment share is a core Vision 2030 target and is tracked closely.
reports._notes: Core labour-market and Saudization node. Tightly linked to Vision 2030.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched GASTAT 'Labor Market Statistics- Q1 2026' quarterly release page with PDF/Excel labour-force data.

reports.title: Public Investment Fund assets and investment framing
reports.description: Statistics and framing of PIF total assets and investment activity. Assets have grown into the multi-trillion-riyal range; the Fund is the central vehicle for domestic mega-projects and international diversification under Vision 2030.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched Public Investment Fund annual reports page listing Annual Report 2021-2025 PDFs.
reports._cadence_evidence: PIF annual reports page lists five consecutive editions - 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 - described as setting out PIF's 'progress year on year'.

reports.title: Banking system credit and asset-quality statistics
reports.description: Statistics on banking system credit growth and non-performing loans. Credit has expanded with economic activity; NPL ratios remain relatively contained in recent readings.
reports._notes: Core banking-system structural and risk node.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched SAMA 'Monthly Bulletin Statistics' page, described as containing monetary and financial statistics on banking activity, finance companies and interest rates.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same SAMA Monthly Bulletin page as sa-bop: the bulletin carrying banking activity, finance-company and payment-system statistics is issued monthly. Shared URL, so this is the one bulletin's cadence.

reports.title: Major merchandise trade partners statistics
reports.description: Statistics on major export and import partners. China, the United States, India, Japan, South Korea and EU members feature prominently for oil and non-oil flows; the UAE is the dominant intra-GCC partner for non-oil trade.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched GASTAT 'International Trade in Goods, May 2026' release page under International Trade Statistics, covering exports/imports and partner countries.
reports._cadence_evidence: GASTAT 'International Trade in Goods, May 2026'; page metadata keywords read 'monthly,international trade for goods,2026,may' and editions are month-labelled.

reports.title: Education enrolment and literacy statistics
reports.description: Statistics on education participation, attainment and literacy. Adult literacy is very high (near 98%); youth participation in education and training is substantial; mean years of schooling have risen under long-term investment.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched GASTAT 'Education and Training Statistics 2025' publication page under Education Statistics, with PDF/Excel downloads.
reports._cadence_evidence: GASTAT 'Education and Training Statistics 2025'; page metadata keyword is 'yearly' and the edition is year-labelled.

reports.title: Life expectancy and health outcome statistics
reports.description: Life expectancy at birth and related health indicators. Life expectancy is in the mid-to-high 70s; non-communicable diseases dominate the mortality profile.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched WHO Data country page for Saudi Arabia showing 'Life expectancy at birth' and 'Leading causes of death, Saudi Arabia' sections.
reports._cadence_evidence: data.who.int country overview for Saudi Arabia is a live interactive data portal; indicators carry mixed data years (2018-2023) and the only date given is an access date ('Accessed on 14 August 2026'), with no stated release cycle.

reports.title: Greenhouse gas emissions statistics
reports.description: National GHG emissions estimates. Energy and oil-related activities dominate the emissions profile; the series is referenced in climate policy, NDC and energy-transition discussions under Vision 2030.
reports._notes: Core climate-measurement node under oil dominance.
reports._url_evidence: Fetched UNFCCC greenhouse gas profile for Saudi Arabia showing total GHG emissions for 1990/2010/2012 by gas and sector.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

domain_semantic_pass.merged_into_existing: Synonyms folded into the 22 already-approved tags (prices→inflation, employment→labour, demography/census→population, monetary/central-bank→monetary-policy, gdp/grdp/regional-accounts→national-accounts, and so on).
domain_semantic_pass.promoted: 17 tags that had earned a slot were promoted out of proposed: and added to Domain in types.ts.
domain_semantic_pass.dropped: Geographic pseudo-tags (regional, provincial, urban, municipal, metropolitan) and batch-meta pseudo-tags (comprehensive, multi-domain, meta, indicators) were removed — geography is already carried by region and jurisdiction_level, and the meta ones describe the batch rather than the report.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.

grok_pass.result: Grok recovered 1 of the 34, independently reproduced all 41 series-level URLs, and returned the other 33 as dead for the same reasons Claude hit.

cadence_research_pass.method: Each node's own verified URL was fetched and the release frequency read off the page — a stated periodicity, an advance release calendar, or a count of dated editions. Numbers carry their evidence in _cadence_evidence. Nothing was inferred from the title alone, and Grok's original text is preserved in _cadence_original.
